newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian PM Ranariddh said target of assassins.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian PM Ranariddh said target of assassins.

text.p: Cambodian co-premier Prince Norodom Ranariddh's chief of security on Wednesday accused political rivals of attempting to assassinate the prince on Tuesday night.
"This is an intentional assassination attempt by (national police chief) Mr. Hok Lundy on the first prime minister," Ranariddh's chief of security Serey Kosal told reporters.
The national police chief is a member of rival co-Premier Hun Sen's Cambodian People's Party. Hun Sen and Ranariddh are both engaged in bitter political rivalry.
Three bodyguards of the two premiers were killed after gun and mortar fire fighting in the Cambodian capital overnight between officials loyal to both leaders.
The police chief has blamed Ranariddh's FUNCINPEC party for the fighting and said that his house had been attacked by 40 armed men sent by FUNCINPEC Secretary of State for the Interior Ho Sok.
Both premiers have called for calm and told their allies to defuse tensions.
